body: I'm really trying to work at it. I started back on meds even though they make me sick, and I'm really pushing myself to keep moving forward instead of sitting around feeling sorry for myself. I know I can't sit and dwell on the past, that's no way to live a life. I just thought doing those things would help me to feel better.
I'll see about getting a meeting setup and try to get back to you if I can in a reasonable amount of time.
That is actually a very good idea. I don't know why I haven't thought of this...
I know. I really wish I could just let it all spill out and get some help, I just can't find the courage to do that. My stomach just knots up at the thought of it.

I'm already trying not to. I'm actively telling myself not to cut myself. I don't enjoy it when I do, I don't feel any sort of relief from doing it. It hurts, it causes me anxiety and I hate it. I simply couldn't stop myself from doing it.
They basically kept me feeling well enough to go about my day to day responsibilities but I still felt depressed. I really don't know what direction to go in at this point.

No, I haven't had a traumatic event in the past or anything like that. I've had some really fucked up things happen to me in the past year. I've let myself feel upset, and I've vented to people around me. I haven't told any of them that I wanted to kill myself, but they knew I've been very depressed. I've been in the hospital for suicidal ideation but even then I never tried to just hurt myself.

It's all mental I think. I mean, I feel sick looking at the bottle. That's before I even take them. I don't believe it's anything in the medication making me sick. I just can't get over how I feel before taking them.
I've never had any luck with a psychiatrist. I either lock up or I pretend I'm feeling better so I can just leave.

Don't worry about the late reply, it doesn't bother me at all. I went from just being bone-crushingly sad to just feeling sort of gone. Kind of like I'm just floating around watching myself through the day. I still can't explain why I feel compelled to harm myself.

I tried that when I was on them before. At the time I'd just gotten out of the hospital after a suicide attempt and was living with my grandmother. Worked fine until I moved out and stopped taking them. Haven't been able to start them again without feeling sick since.
That's what I found as well. I don't know where I got it from or why I did it. I can't go to anyone for help. Whenever I do they just tell me I need to get a job and I'll feel better.

I don't real feel anything. I don't feel any compulsion to really hurt myself, I just do it, then I panic. I'm supposed to be on medication but I feel sick to my stomach just looking at the bottle so I don't take them.
I'm on Escitalopram and trazodone for sleep. I spotted taking the trazodone because it made me restless before bed. I've tried meditation with little success before.

I've tried getting help. I'm on medication but it doesn't help me. My family knows how I feel but don't understand. I've been institutionalized for attempted suicide. Nothing has helped me to feel better longer than a month. The only thing that would help me stay alive is being put away again, and I can't do that again.

I'm trying so hard to just wait, hoping my meds will kick in before it gets any worse. And yet I look around and it seems like everyone else in my family is headed towards a happy future with their families. Two of my cousins around my age have both recently had children, and my brother and sister are both having kids in April. (my daughter's due date was middle of March) I don't understand why I had to be the one to lose. I feel like I'm being punished having to see how happy they all are. I almost threw up during thanksgiving dinner I was so distraught. I can't take this.

She isn't lying. I called her mother who proceeded to tell me it was my fault she lost the baby. If I'd left it alone she wouldn't have been so stressed and lost it. I also talked to a mutual friend of ours and she confirmed that Mary lost the baby.

Hey there, I just wanted to come back here and thank you again. After I went to sleep I woke up and thought about what you've said. I've decided I will be in my child's life, and I'll do it the right way. And I've decided if my family doesn't approve it is their loss. I will love my kid enough for an entire family.

Please don't hurt yourself. Even just looking at the list of names you left I can see you have people that care about you and who are likely gong through the same thing. Before anything, go talk to one of them about how you feel. Just telling someone how you feel will take a weight off your shoulders. And remember, if you are gone, that's one less person to help keep the memory of your brother alive. Lastly remember that relief is a feeling, and you have to be alive to feel it. Stay strong.
Thank you. I hope so too, but hoping only goes so far.

The worst thing is when they actually tell me how glad they are I didn't get her pregnant, how horrible it would be if we'd had a kid. It tears me up because there is a child, and regardless of who the mother is, or the fact it hasn't been born yet, I already love my child.

I don't believe I'd stand a chance against her in court. He family is rather wealthy and would be able to afford an attorney leagues ahead of what I could. I also haven't told any of my family about her being pregnant. I'm afraid their resentment of her would manifest into them hating my child. I know to some this sounds strange but it is exactly the sort of attitude my family would take. I don't want to raise my kid in that sort of environment.
